text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75–4.00% with markets pricing further increases to 4.3% by December — combined with CPI stuck at 3.4% and GDP slowing to 1.5%, this creates a stagflationary setup that could pressure stock valuations, especially for unprofitable or speculative holdings.

QBTS is down 38% and 61% from its high as a speculative quantum computing play with no earnings support — reduce your exposure before further losses pile up, especially with rates rising and making unprofitable companies harder to justify.

MicroStrategy is a leveraged Bitcoin bet sitting 55% off its high with enormous volatility — in a rising rate environment, this kind of speculative concentration adds outsized risk to your portfolio and should be trimmed.

Adobe looks undervalued at a PE of just 8.6 with 10.5% revenue growth and outstanding free cash flow — this is a profitable, cash-generating business on sale, and adding here at a discount makes sense for long-term holders.
Micron has exceptional relative strength, bullish momentum above its 50-day average, and strong fundamentals behind the AI memory demand story — worth adding on this strength.
Google at a PE of 23 with 15% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and insider buying represents solid value in a market where quality matters more than ever with rates heading higher.

UnitedHealth is down 10% with nearly 12% revenue growth and a strong 4.8% free cash flow yield — this defensive healthcare leader is pulling back to a level worth adding to for its resilience in a slowing economy.
